text:
You’re looking to build a proprietary algorithm that uses your historical case studies to improve marketing decisions and better identify the right clients and products more efficiently.

I’m Noor Halden, and I’d be glad to help you approach this as both an algorithm design effort and a practical business consultation. I have 6 years of experience in machine learning and NLP, with hands-on work in Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning systems.

For example, on a product recommendations project for Tidewater Outfitters in e-commerce, I built similar-items and “you-may-also-like” carousels trained on 1.2M interactions and cached the results in Redis. That work led to a 14% click-through rate lift in a 4-week A/B test. The project required turning real usage history into a recommendation system that could support business goals, which is closely aligned with what you’re aiming to do with your brokerage data.

For your use case, I’d focus on understanding the structure of your case studies, defining the prediction or ranking targets clearly, and then shaping an approach that can evolve with your business. Depending on the quality and consistency of the data, that could include classification, ranking, recommendation, or other predictive modeling techniques. I’d also want the first meeting to function as a working consultation, just as you described, so we can discuss what your data contains, what decisions you want the model to support, and what a realistic first version should look like.

I’m comfortable being fully immersed in a project and working through the details needed to create something proprietary and useful, rather than a generic model. If selected, I’d come prepared with questions about your historical data, current marketing workflow, and the specific outcomes you want to improve, so we can map the right technical approach from the start.

If you’d like, I can help you turn your existing case studies into a practical algorithm strategy that gives your team a real edge.
